features.observation: The ground rises into a broad central ridge before falling toward the outer edge.
features.designConstraint: Keep the central ridge wider than the edge and readable in both side and oblique captures.

features.observation: The outer rim shows two visible strata with a shallow ledge between them.
features.designConstraint: Model two continuous strata and a ledge; do not substitute isolated rocks for the rim profile.

features.observation: The broad top is matte while exposed sides are darker and visibly rougher.
features.designConstraint: Use separate top and exposed-side material response so the profile remains readable under the key light.

implementationPlan.geometryStrategy: Create a sampled BufferGeometry heightfield and a separately profiled edge wall.
constructionSteps: Sample the registered surface profile on a regular grid and preserve its central ridge.
Generate the rim strata from the edge profile and verify continuity in side captures.
implementationPlan.materialTreatment: Assign matte sediment to the upper surface and rough dark basalt to exposed strata.
